title: Machine learning model estimates hemoglobin response to Zaizao Shengxue capsule in anemia
summary: A prospective multicenter real-world study of 440 anemia patients from 14 centers found that 204 (46.4%) responded (hemoglobin rise of at least 20 g/L at week 8), with response rates of 24.0% (60/250) in cancer-related anemia, 74.4% (67/90) in iron-deficiency anemia and 77.0% (77/100) in anemia of chronic disease. Ten candidate models were trained on the development cohort (n=338; 238 training, 100 internal validation) and the locked model was evaluated in 102 patients from four external centers, with anemia etiology, age and eGFR retained as predictors. SHAP and LIME were used for interpretation. The study is single-arm and performance values were not visible in the abstract excerpt.
